purpose: Offline deterministic feasibility planner for community workshops; joint room, equipment, capacity, instructor and group scheduling, no production bookings.
api: plan(document: dict, *, max_nodes: int = 20000) -> dict; InputError(ValueError); never mutate input

rooms.resources: optional distinct list of IDs, default []

workshops.allowed_starts: optional distinct ints 0..slots-duration, default all valid
workshops.allowed_rooms: optional distinct existing room IDs, default all rooms

constraints: Each workshop assigned exactly once at a contiguous start slot, finishing <= slots.
Room cannot overlap; no blocked room slot may be used.
attendees <= room capacity and required resources subset of room resources.
Shared instructors or groups cannot overlap even in different rooms.
All explicit allowed_rooms and allowed_starts respected; empty permitted list means no candidates.
search: Sort rooms/workshops IDs; create candidates by ascending start then room ID; pick static increasing candidate-count then workshop-ID order. DFS try candidates; increment nodes for every candidate conflict check, including conflict; if all search exhausted return unsatisfiable. Before trying candidate with nodes == max_nodes return budget_exhausted unless solution or complete exhaustion already proved. Empty workshops scheduled with nodes0. Return first feasible, no optimality claim.
output_rules: assignments sorted by workshop ID when scheduled; otherwise [] (no partial solution)
status unsatisfiable means exhaustive proof within this finite input; budget_exhausted must never become unsatisfiable
Unknown fields/invalid type/duplicate IDs/out of bounds/missing field raise InputError without echoing input values.
cli: python -m planejador_oficinas INPUT.json [--max-nodes N]; stdout JSON only; exit0 scheduled/1 unsatisfiable/3 budget_exhausted/2 invalid or file error; strict UTF8 JSON, reject duplicate keys and nonfinite numbers, max1MiB; fixed safe errors, do not echo arbitrary input/path values.
docs: Portuguese README, deterministic feasible/impossible/resource-exhaustion examples, API and limits, distinction from freebusy-slot-studio/calendar and taskgraph-plan, MIT, contributing/security docs. No credentials/network/production integration.
